nodes.label: Claude-specific logic isolation rule
nodes.rationale: CLI flags, stream-json parsing, and session-file conventions must stay inside providers/claude_code/ and never leak into db/ or commands.rs, so those two modules remain agent-agnostic and support future non-Claude providers.

nodes.label: Sandbox parameterization (forward-looking)
nodes.rationale: Image builds should be parameterized per-provider (different CLIs, auth mechanisms, firewall allowlist domains) rather than assuming one fixed sandbox image works for every agent backend, since future providers are not assumed to have feature parity with Claude Code.
